description.value: A heritage boutique hotel occupying a restored 1913 warehouse in downtown Victoria, Swans offers 31 loft-style suites featuring exposed brick, original timber beams, and artworks from the founder's personal collection. The building also houses a full-production brewery, a pub with 58 beers on tap, and a liquor store — making it a destination in its own right. It sits at the edge of Victoria's oldest Chinatown, within easy walking distance of the harbour and the city's downtown core.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 35m; stands (2 spaces) at 40m; stands (2 spaces) at 46m; stands (6 spaces) at 51m; stands (4 spaces) at 58m; stands at 61m; stands (8 spaces) at 78m; rack at 95m. Total: 26 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Swans Hotel & Brewpub as an active, operating 31-room boutique hotel at 506 Pandora Ave, Victoria, with phone 250.361.3310 matching OSM. Room amenity lists explicitly mention 'On-site Laundry' and 'Secure WIFI (FREE)' on multiple room types; the site also lists an on-site pub with 58 beers on tap as well as extensive nearby dining options. No bike storage, bike-specific procedures, drying area, e-bike charging, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: The website lists a separate phone number and address for the on-site pub component (250.940.7513, 1601 Store St) which differs from the OSM-listed hotel phone and address; OSM records only the hotel, so this is not a discrepancy but worth noting for directory completeness.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating boutique hotel with a confirmed web presence, matching contact details, and on-site food and drink — clearly useful to touring cyclists staying in Victoria.

Laundry.detail: Website room amenity lists for Studio, One Bedroom, and Two Bedroom suites all include 'On-site Laundry'
